announcement: Sleeping Guddi v0.4.1 resolves silent audio on downloaded MP4 videos, startup white-screen issues, and improves cinematic resolution detection!
features: Audio Playback Fix: Auto-transcodes YouTube Opus audio to standard AAC LC in MP4 files for full Windows & mobile compatibility
Startup Stability: Fixed white-screen crash on startup caused by player duration initialization order
Smart Resolution Tiers: Ultrawide cinematic videos (e.g. 1920×788) now properly display as 1080p HD matching YouTube
Mini-Player Audio: Fixed Web Audio API cross-origin audio graph silencing in the built-in mini player
Reliable Downloads: Enhanced final file detection to ensure .part and thumbnail files are filtered out
